reviews.title: Basic editing app
reviews.text: I downloaded and paid ₹999 for this app based on reviews. For iOS this is just a basic app. There are better apps out there for editing. What a waste of money.

reviews.title: Very basic editing
reviews.text: Still providing very basic editing no new transition no voice enhancement, even a free Instagram edit app provide enhance voice feature no fast video review or playback so that at the time of editing, I have to review my video at 1X speed only at least make it 1.254 1.50 so that I can review faster and edit faster, add some template, transition, voice enhancement,etc latest features

reviews.title: Easy to use
reviews.text: The app is user friendly, every features required for editing video is available except the sound effects which is behind paywall. I cannot even use a cat’s meow or dog’s bark without paying. Just great.

reviews.title: Glitches
reviews.text: This app is full of glitches and bugs. Facing glitches and bugs even while basic trimming of 1080p 30fps videos. Really feels like I wasted my money on such an unstable app. Even heavy apps like Davinci Resolve free version are free of glitches and bugs. I have iPad Air 4th gen.

reviews.title: Very Poor Communication
reviews.text: I recently updated to the last version of this app and now I can't use it anymore as my Macmini is not running OSX 26 but the previous OS as my music apps don't like this new OS... so I can't use it anymore. An email, or a message in the app would have been useful. Now there is a message in the app store but it lets you download it anyway and then you can't use  your app anymore and can't downgrade. It is unacceptable and very amateur
